patronOf.en-US: The people acclaim the Lord's Death and Resurrection
patronOf.pt-BR: O povo aclama a morte e a ressurreição do Senhor

prayerExcerpt.en-US: The mystery of faith. We proclaim your Death, O Lord, and profess your Resurrection until you come again.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Mistério da fé! Anunciamos, Senhor, a vossa morte e proclamamos a vossa ressurreição. Vinde, Senhor Jesus!

meta.basis: After the Consecration, when the priest, having shown the chalice and genuflected, has said The mystery of faith, 'the people pronounce the acclamation, using one of the prescribed formulas' (GIRM 151; the Order of Mass rubric), still kneeling until after the Amen (GIRM 43, USCCB). The acclamation is the people's, so the card is on them, as on the Responsorial Psalm.
